g.title: wagner_blocks
g.text: 200 vertices: five subdivided Wagner graphs joined by four 20-cycles of connectors

g.title: titleW
g.text: one block: the Wagner graph with every rim edge subdivided twice

g.title: titleK
g.text: the five blocks and the four 20-cycles

g.title: sidesTag
g.text: sides: the two 20-cycles of steps +1 and -1, eight edges on each side

g.title: diagTag
g.text: diagonals: the two 20-cycles of steps +2 and -2, eight edges on each diagonal
